question: Should OpenClaw accept static Codex model pricing defaults in the bundled catalog, or should this fix recompute only from operator-configured/live pricing?
rationale: The routing regression is mechanical, but assigning built-in prices to Codex catalog rows changes cost reporting semantics for users who previously saw missing or zero cost.

options.title: Accept static Codex defaults after rebase
options.body: Keep the known model price table once the branch preserves the canonical OpenAI/Codex API route and proves configured-free and stale-zero behavior.

options.title: Require configured/live pricing only
options.body: Remove bundled static prices and limit the resolver to recomputing stale zero cost only when pricing is already available from user config or live catalog metadata.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Close or hold the branch if maintainers do not want bundled Codex pricing policy in core right now.

recommendation.title: Accept static Codex defaults after rebase
recommendation.body: Keep the known model price table once the branch preserves the canonical OpenAI/Codex API route and proves configured-free and stale-zero behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision intersects the OpenAI/Codex identity unification and recent Codex catalog ownership history.
